notes.title: v1.4 update notes
notes.notes:
What's new


 Added 2 new chapters.
 Added a mini tps test chapter.
 Added chapter selection.
 Changed the way the pixel dlc version runs to save disk space.
 Performance improved. Known bugs fixed.
 Auto-save feature has been added between levels.
 Radar visual changed.

notes.title: First Update of 2020, v1.3 is here!
notes.notes:
We all are craving for some change in our lives nowadays since everyone is closed in their homes. As CDIS, we bring it to you with the spirit of the 80s and 90s. Our games are now available as pixel based DLC pack. Retro lovers, do not miss this opportunity!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011684/66a770a0372512fe273fbb0cf33d0949fc581b9b.jpg

Stay tuned if you want to be the first to know about updates, deals, announcements and news.

notes.title: The v1.2 update is with you!
notes.notes:
We continue making improvents to meet your wishes with new updates. We have not forgotten to work on performance tweaks while debugging our games. This v1.2 update, which doesn't have direct affects on gameplay rather it is focused on increasing your gaming comfort and joy, will be with you through Black Friday opportunities.

Stay tuned if you want to be the first to know about updates, deals, announcements and news.

notes.title: First major update v1.1 incoming!
notes.notes:
We have started debugging and developing all our games. Updates will be with you this summer. Also Steam achievements are in progress.
